Definition: to undulate (as the earth, the sky, etc.; also a field of grain), particularly through fear; specifically, to spring (as a locust)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to quake, shake; 1a) (Qal) to quake, shake; 1b) (Niphal) to be made to quake; 1c)(Hiphil); 1c1) to cause to quake; 1c2) to cause to spring or leap (of horse)
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
